chapters: Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Amoos ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ bipia'dam gu Tekoa jix ñi' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu tanoolh gu Ussiia gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu tanoolh gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam va'k gi'ndukɨ.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu Sioon maa'n gu ñi'ook dɨr gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr dhi' bipia'dam gu Karmelo.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik uañi'ñ gu Damasko maakobh cham sɨlhka'n; na gu' jix duñia' gu Galaad bɨɨx jix duñia' jix kavɨk jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai gu vaak gu asael gu Benadad.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Damasko gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Bikat-aben gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Bet-eden; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu Aram ka't bhaan gu Kîr tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik uañi'ñ gu Gasa maakobh cham sɨlhka'n; na gu' jix duñia' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x na ba' kɨɨsa' gu Edom.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai vaak jodai gu Gasa.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Asoto gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Askaloon; gio ba' gu novɨ bhaan gu Ekroon gu Palestinos jix koi tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik uañi'ñ gu Tiro maakobh cham sɨlhka'n; na gu' kapbhai' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Edom cham gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai vaak jodai gu Tiro.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik uañi'ñ gu Edom maakobh cham sɨlhka'n; na gu' xibhɨk; jano' ba' bɨɨx i'iich tu' bɨɨx tas tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai gu Temaan gu Bosra.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook vaik uañi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu ñi'ook maakobh cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam sɨlhka'n; na gu' gu Galaad na ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai vaak jodai gu Rabba bɨɨx gu tanoolh bɨɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' bɨx tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik uañi'ñ gu Moab maakobh cham sɨlhka'n; na gu' gu ñi'ook o'oo gu gɨ'kora' gu Idumea bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai gu Moab gu Kêriot; gio ba' koi gu Moab gu jodai' na jix uam kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bɨx bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ kooda' bɨɨx bɨx chiñia' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik uañi'ñ gu Judaa maakobh cham sɨlhka'n; na gu' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios cham nukadham; jano' ba' tu' jix duu tu jiim tattat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik uañi'ñ gu Israeel maakobh cham sɨlhka'n; na gu' gu ñi'ook tuumiñ jir bhai' gampai'.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' ka't oo' gu oidha' bhaan mo'o bia' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu taat baap jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Amorreo jix duñia' ka't na ja'p jix duñia' gɨ' u'u kavɨk jix kavɨk na ja'p; gio ba' gu i'bhɨ jiix.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto oidha' jix gaki oo'm na ba' pai' gu Amorreo.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam na ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan biipibop na ba' bhaai'n gu Nasareos; gio ba' cham dhi' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨɨdak i'i suudai' u'va gu Nasareos; gio ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bham; mi' dhɨr cham.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' pai' na ja'p jix bhuup gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x jix kavɨk cham gu kavɨk tu' jix kavɨk gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x tɨɨt tu' jix duñia' kavaayo u'ua'tɨda' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨbiaptuda mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bhaan bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu oidha'; na ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook bɨx tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gook tɨtda:―Aañ tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maavɨt gu kavɨk cham gu ñi'ook maa'n dɨr gu vaak na jix bhai' tu' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'uvhig jix duñia' gu oidha' cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oidha' tu' cham tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' kuichdha' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk kiicham cham gu jodai' na jix uam gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' kiicham gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook ɨxchuixim tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maavɨt chɨkka cham gu ñi'ook a'gi'ñchu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Asoto bhaan gu oidha' gu Ejipto ja'xñi; gio ba' bhaan gu kakkavɨk gu Samaria mumua'da' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' bhaamki'ñdha' bɨx gu oidha' tu' gu kavɨk ka't.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bipia'dam jix duñia' gu chin maavɨt gook gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Samaria gu ñi'ook dhim.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jakob tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Na gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel bhaan gio bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Bet-el; gio ba' ka't a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu vaak gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix koi; gio ba' mumua'da' gu vaak ka't tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Basaan gu kavɨk gu Samaria bia' gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan; gio ba' i'i.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam boopoya' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bet-el; gio ba' gu Gilgal uañi'ñ gu xibh makgɨrxi'ñdha' boosgi vaik.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar bhai' ñi'ook bɨɨx maa'nkar na jix maa; na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gio tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam taatam bɨx jɨ'dɨlh uañi'ñ gu takarui' bɨx gu ja'tkam; gu' cham tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gio tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhuuk vaik masaa'n va'k oraa'; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan kiicham bhaan kiicham cham gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bhaan baasɨ'n; jano' ba' baasɨ'n bhaan cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' aajidha' gook vaik jɨ'dɨlh kiicham na ba' i'i gu suudai' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨɨx bɨx cham tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu jɨvɨl; gio ba' mui'x oidha' u'va iigɨx jix jugi gu ñi'ook; gu' cham pai' dhuuk tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto; gio ba' biipibop bɨɨx kavaayo; mi' dhɨr tu' jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx ka'm; gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk bhaan na ja'p na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios ia'lhxichulh gu Sodoma gu Gomorra gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tai; gu' cham tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia' gu kakkavɨk gu jɨvɨl gu chio'ñ; na duñia' gu tukgam gu xibh bhaan gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Na gu' jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Israeel cham jix búup; gio ba' tɨtda:―Cha'pim ka't bhaan gu oidha' cham cham tu'x jai'ch jix duñia'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook bɨɨx chamaam; mi' dhɨr chamaam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx mambhɨɨx gu vaak gu Israeel.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duaka'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bet-el tu' gu Gilgal tu' gu Beer-seba; na gu' gu Gilgal ka't gu Bet-el ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham ka't na ja'p gu tai gu vaak gu Josee jix duñia' cham gu Bet-el.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu oidha' bɨx bhai'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia' gu Arkturo gu Orioon gu tukgam gu xibh duñia' gu tanoolh gu tukaa'; na mɨmɨim gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' biiñ bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Na jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jix kavɨk bhaan gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'rgidhimɨk jix duñia'.
Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gampai' gu ñi'ook tiriik; gio ba' gu vaak gu' cham; mi' dhɨr gu ux na tu ibai' oidha' u'va gu' cham i'i suudai' u'va.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mumua'da' uañi'ñ; na jir bhai' jix duñia' bia' ki'ñgob xoi'kam kuiñcha.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na gu' gu ñi'ook cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai' cham cham bhai' na ba'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ ka't bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ja'p tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' xoi'kam ñi'ook na jir bhai' ki'ñgob; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ jix duñia' gu Josee.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook tɨɨt suanda'.
Jano' ba' bɨx oidha' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; na gu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tukgam cham gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan maavɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx; gio ba' tu' ba'k gu vaak gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' cham ka't gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios gu tukgam cham gu tasi'; gio ba' gu tukgam cham juraa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan cham tu jiim; gio ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' xoi'kam cham.
Jano' ba' va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' na ja'p gu suudai' bɨx bhai' na ja'p jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam makgɨrxi'ñdha' oidha' jix gaki oo'm gu vaak gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Molok gu Kiuun duiñxim chi'ɨɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Damasko tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sioon gu kavɨk gu Samaria gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam aajim bhaan gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kalne gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu amat; mi' dhɨr gu Gat gu Palestinos; jano' ba' tu' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' tutkɨ dhi' ja'tkam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' tu' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh cham bhai' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam Cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' bhaan; gio ba' kua'da' ali' karneer kakneer gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ja'p gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va bɨɨx; gio ba' cham gu Josee.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' no'ñ gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr kiicham kapbhai' bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu vaak koi.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu ñi'ook na ba' o'oo gu vaak; gio ba' gu vaak; mi' dhɨr cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook oi'ñdha' bɨndak; jano' ba' cham; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' cham jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu vaak jix gɨ' gu vaak jix ali' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kavaayo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix duñia' ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu ux na tu ibai' gu i'bhɨ bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham bɨxchu'x bɨɨx gu kavɨk.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ja'tkam tu jiim dɨr ba'k gu amat bɨɨx ka'm jix duu oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam kua'da'; mi' dhɨr ka't mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu jugi gu vaas gu oidha' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jano'; na gu' chɨkka jix búup gu Jakob na gu' jix ali'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios dhi'; gio ba' cham ka't jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tɨɨt na ba' gu tai gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix dhaam suudai' baasɨ'n gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jano'; na gu' chɨkka jix búup gu Jakob na gu' jix ali'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios dhi'; gio ba' cham ka't dhi' jix aa' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan ka't bhaan vaak jodai gu ñi'ook gu novɨ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios jano' ba'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amoos tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' gu Jawatan jix aa'; gio ba' gu Miren tu' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr cham.
Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Isaak ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na jix bhaan gu Israeel ka't; gio ba' bɨɨx gu kuchii bhaan gu vaak gu Jeroboam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Amasiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Bet-el bhañ a'ga gu Jeroboam gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Amoos tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' cham jɨ'xdha' bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Amoos; gio ba' gu Jeroboam koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Israeel gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Amasiias gu Amoos; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Judaa jugi gu takarui' jix duñia'.
Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bet-el na gu' xidhuu gu gɨ'kora' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Amoos gu Amasiias; gio ba' cham jix duñia' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' jix duñia' gu mar jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiiw.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ bhaan gu vaakax gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham bhaan gu Israeel tu' tu ñi'ook bhaan gu vaak gu Isaak.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu u'vɨ kiicham gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu oidha' ka't gu ñi'ook mamai'chɨk; mi' dhɨr tu' koi gu oidha' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tu' gu Israeel ka't bhaan pai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amoos tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tɨbiap tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr cham.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' mui'x ka't gu chuukug koko'kam; mi' dhɨr bɨx pai' ka't duiñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam bia' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' bham; gio ba' duuk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bi'iix tiriik; mi' dhɨr kia'pɨx bhi'spio'kai ulhña' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook u'uuk gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tanoolh na jix bhai'.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bia' tuumiñ bi'iix tiriik.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jakob; gio ba' cham gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x na ba' bɨɨx tas bɨx buimɨi.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bhaan dhi' bɨx cham jix tɨ'ɨ bɨx na ja'p gɨ' suudai' jiim ka't na ja'p gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu tas saagi'ñ gu oidha' gu tukgam gu tanoolh jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suanda' bɨx xoi'kam; gio ba' jix dhaas bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx mo'o; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tanoolh gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios bhiogi' gu oidha' cham bhiogi' gu takarui' tu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' dɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm tas buusñi gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook biipibop gu ñi'ook.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ gu Samaria tu ñi'ook gu Bibe gu Jawatan Dios gu Dan; gio ba' gu Bibe gu bhóogɨt gu Beer-seba; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk jix búup.
Ba' jix aa' tu' gu Jawatan ka't bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiki'ñgob; mi' dhɨr mo'o bɨx; jano' ba' kuugalhdha' kooda'; gio ba' cham tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr jix dhaav.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Karmelo gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu vupui jix dhaam suudai' gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ mu'aa; gio ba' bhaan gu vupui na ba' cham bhai' cham na ba' xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oidha' tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bɨx na ja'p gɨ' suudai' jiim na ja'p gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tɨkɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhi' gu tɨkɨr bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' mɨmɨim gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' biiñ; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu ma'nkam gu Etiopes cham tu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu Palestinos gu Kaptor gu Kîr gu Arameos.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ua'tulhdhix tu' gu vupui gu oidha'; gu' cham bɨx gu vaak gu Jakob tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu vaak gu Israeel ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx chɨbɨɨp na ja'p kai'ñ cham gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi bɨx u'ua'tulhdhix gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook tu' cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Dabii na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' na ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam bhaan tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Idumea bɨx gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios duñia' dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu kai'; gio ba' gu kakkavɨk bɨx tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh jix daa; gio ba' gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va i'i suudai' u'va; mi' dhɨr jix duu jugi gu i'bhɨ.
Na gu' gu ux na tu ibai' bhaan gu oidha' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu oidha' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
